source: NOAA NCEI Integrated Surface Database (Global Hourly), via the NOAA Open Data bucket

screen.rule: usable: >= 10 years with >= 2000 hours carrying a valid wind report; primary: nearest usable with >= 7000 such hours in >= 10 years

publish_decision.rule: published only if (1) a usable hourly station exists within the screen radius, (2) notebook 02 has measured a dune heading for the site, and (3) every other usable station within the radius gives a resultant drift direction within 45 deg of the primary station's at the synoptic hours they share, i.e. the stations agree on the regional regime
